answer: The tempe workshop smells of warm soybeans and banana leaf. Proof of tempe-maker via soybean cake tally — a cake the tempe-maker ferments only after 31 cakes bind firm without one crumbling at the cut, each fermented by the tempe-maker himself. tide packs the inoculated beans tight in the leaf and folds the edges shut. spiral sets the parcels in the warm room and checks the white spread. garden unwraps a finished cake and presses it firm. Thirty-one cakes must bind firm without one cake crumbling at the cut, and the next still falls apart where the leaf was folded loose.
